patterns.note: Full-bleed hero image with overlaid text, followed by content sections that feature generous vertical padding and a left-aligned content block within a wider container.
Prominent, bold sans-serif headings are used for key messages, creating a strong visual hierarchy against lighter weight body text and uppercase navigation links.
A clean, bright palette of white and black is accented by a vibrant, almost lime green for calls to action and interactive elements, complemented by natural wood tones from imagery.
Content sections reveal their elements (headings, paragraphs, and buttons) with a staggered fade-up or slide-up animation as their section enters the viewport during scrolling.
A distinct green hamburger menu icon remains fixed to the right edge of the screen, providing persistent navigation access as the user scrolls down the page.
Content sections incorporate a large, faint, brand-specific graphic as a background element, adding subtle visual interest and reinforcing brand identity without obscuring text.

technique_notes: The hero section uses a full-bleed background image with text positioned directly over it. The main navigation scrolls away with the hero.

Content sections are designed to reveal their internal elements progressively. As a section scrolls into view, its text blocks and interactive components animate in with a subtle fade and upward slide effect.
A hamburger menu icon is implemented as a fixed-position element, ensuring it remains visible and accessible on the right side of the screen regardless of scroll depth.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) provide strong visual anchors, complemented by legible body text and smaller uppercase navigation links.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle; buttons and interactive elements feature slightly rounded corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy; generous vertical padding is used in the hero and between major content sections, creating a spacious and uncluttered feel.

standout: This site stands out by effectively blending a clean, modern aesthetic with a playful and nurturing educational theme. The use of a vibrant green accent, a distinctive logo with colorful elements, and subtle, large-scale background graphics within content sections creates a welcoming yet sophisticated feel that elevates it beyond a generic school website.
